verdict.rationale: Scheduled jobs (cron-style tasks or recurring workflows) are a fair capability for a managed database platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no scheduler, cron, or recurring-workflow feature. Automated branching per pull request is an event-driven, one-off action rather than a recurring schedule, and the Platform API and MCP server are building blocks, so none of these earn credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
